images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent production sprite sheet for ONE new farm animal walking in place. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match the existing farm cow/lamb/chicken rounded cream pastel body, warm tan medium thin outlines, tiny dot eyes, simple flat fills, restrained soft cel shading, non-pixel 2D storybook game art. No white sticker border, no black outlines, no textures. Exactly 12 distinct sequential poses in a strict evenly spaced 4 column by 3 row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell has the identical scale and camera, parallel ground axes approximately ±0.5, elevated three-quarter view facing lower left. Entire animal fully visible in every cell with generous clear gutters; no touching adjacent cells. Fixed torso proportions and fixed location per cell, no progressive world travel. Frames 0–11 are an evenly sampled seamless 1 second gait cycle; frame 11 leads into frame 0 without copying it. Authentic alternating limb articulation with lift, swing, plant and push, gentle head counter-motion, no rigid whole-image wobble. Separate near/far limbs remain readable. Uniform body size, marking placement, outline thickness and face across ALL frames. True RGBA transparency; NO shadows, ground, food, props, labels, numbers, panels or gridlines. Target sheet 1536x1152 (4x3 square cells). Animal: small plump cream domestic duck with a pale honey-orange broad bill and two webbed feet, tiny tucked wings, short raised tail. A soft waddling WALK with alternating left/right webbed feet and subtle head stabilization. Reference chicken styling, but unmistakable duck with no comb.
